_notes.app_dir: where the code is checked out (deploy.sh clones/pulls here)
_notes.data_dir: persistent disk for DB + uploads + publications + media; survives redeploys
_notes.service_user: Linux user that owns the files and runs the service
_notes.secret_key: leave empty to auto-generate once into data_dir/.flask_secret
_notes.enable_pdf: true installs headless Chromium for broadsheet/gazette PDF export
_notes.git_push: true -> the weekly maintenance commits the DB + media and pushes to origin (the server's git remote must be push-authenticated)
